fullPassage: Near the equator, many species of bird breed all year round. But in temperate and polar regions, the breeding seasons of birds are often sharply defined. They are triggered mainly by changes in day length. If all goes well, the outcome is that birds raise their young when the food supply is at its peak. Most birds are not simply reluctant to breed at other times but they are also physically incapable of doing so. This is because their reproductive system shrinks, which helps flying birds save weight. The main exception to this rule are nomadic desert species. These can initiate their breeding cycle within days of rain. It's for making the most of the sudden breeding opportunity. Also, different species divide the breeding season up in different ways. Most seabirds raise a single brood. In warm regions, however, songbirds may raise several families in a few months. In an exceptionally good year, a pair of House Sparrows, a kind of songbird, can raise successive broods through a marathon reproductive effort.

✅ ② (A) 번식하다 — (B) 품종: (A)는 동사로 번식, (B)는 명사로 품종 ←정답
❌ ③ (A) 기르다 — (B) 습관: (B)에 습관 의미 없음
❌ ④ (A) 사육하다 — (B) 종류: (A)는 자연 번식이지 사육이 아님
det.tip: (A) breed(v) = 번식하다 vs (B) breed(n) = 품종

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "unwilling or hesitant to do something"

det.korean: reluctant=꺼리는: 무언가를 하기를 원하지 않거나 주저하는
det.analysis:
❌ ① nomadic: nomadic(유목의)은 이동 생활에 관한 것
❌ ② successive: successive(연이은)는 순서에 관한 것
✅ ③ reluctant: reluctant(꺼리는)는 영영 정의에 정확히 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ reproductive: reproductive(생식의)는 번식에 관한 것
det.tip: reluctant = unwilling or hesitant

questions.passage: Most birds are not simply reluctant to breed at other times but they are also physically incapable of __________ (do) so.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: do → doing: 전치사 of 뒤에 동명사(V-ing) 필요
det.analysis: incapable of __________ (do) so — 전치사 of 뒤에 동명사가 필요. doing
det.tip: incapable of doing — 전치사 of + 동명사 = ~하는 것이 불가능한

questions.passage: In an exceptionally good year, a pair of House Sparrows, a kind of songbird, can raise successive broods through a marathon __________ (reproduce) effort.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: reproduce → reproductive: 명사(effort) 앞에 형용사 필요
det.analysis: a marathon __________ (reproduce) effort — 명사 effort 앞에 형용사가 필요. reproductive(생식의)
det.tip: reproductive effort — 동사 reproduce → 형용사 reproductive

questions.passage: Near the equator, many species of bird breed all year round. But in temperate and polar regions, the breeding seasons of birds are often sharply defined. They are triggered mainly by changes in day length. If all goes well, the outcome is that birds raise their young when __________. Most birds are not simply reluctant to breed at other times but they are also physically incapable of doing so. This is because their reproductive system shrinks, which helps flying birds save weight. The main exception to this rule are nomadic desert species. These can initiate their breeding cycle within days of rain. It's for making the most of the sudden breeding opportunity. Also, different species divide the breeding season up in different ways. Most seabirds raise a single brood. In warm regions, however, songbirds may raise several families in a few months. In an exceptionally good year, a pair of House Sparrows, a kind of songbird, can raise successive broods through a marathon reproductive effort.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 먹이 공급이 최고점에 달할 때 (새끼를 기르는 결과를 만든다)
det.analysis:
✅ ① 먹이 공급이 최고점 — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② 기온이 최저 — 번식에 불리한 조건
❌ ③ 포식자가 떠남 — 본문에 언급 없음
❌ ④ 낮 시간이 최단 — 번식 촉발은 낮 길이 변화이지 최단이 아님
det.tip: birds raise their young when the food supply is at its peak
